cues.note: a bare knuckle landing on flesh
cues.prompt: A bare-knuckle punch lands hard on flesh: a dull fleshy thud with a short wet slap on top of it. Close microphone, dry room, one single impact.
A sharp claw rakes across flesh: a short wet tearing scrape with a faint squelch at the end. Close microphone, dry room, one single impact.

cues.note: a hoof stamping onto a body
cues.prompt: A heavy hoof stamps onto a body: a deep low thud with a hard knock underneath it. Close microphone, dry room, one single impact.

cues.note: a wooden club swinging into a body
cues.prompt: A heavy wooden club swings into a body: a dull woody crack followed by a fleshy thump. Close microphone, dry room, one single impact.

cues.note: a metal spike driving into flesh
cues.prompt: A metal spike drives into flesh: a sharp metallic scrape and a sudden wet puncture. Close microphone, dry room, one single impact.

cues.note: the same fist against a hard surface, to check the material axis
cues.prompt: A bare-knuckle fist slams into a sheet of metal armour: a hard metallic clang with a dull thud underneath it. Close microphone, dry room, one single impact.

cues.note: the same club against a hard surface
cues.prompt: A wooden club slams into a sheet of metal armour: a hard metallic clang with a hollow woody knock underneath it. Close microphone, dry room, one single impact.

cues.note: the wind of a big limb coming through the air
cues.prompt: A heavy arm swings through the air: a broad low whoosh that swells and cuts off sharply. Close microphone, dry room, one single movement.

cues.note: the wind of a fast, light limb
cues.prompt: A fast light fist cuts through the air: a thin sharp whoosh with a little whistle. Close microphone, dry room, one single movement.

cues.note: an experiment: can the same model carry a fighter's voice?
cues.prompt: A very large heavy fighter grunts with effort while striking: a low rough wordless exhale, chesty and strained. Close microphone, dry room, one single vocalisation.
